issue.description: archive_partition function does too much: creates dirs, runs subprocess, drops table. Hard to test and reuse.
issue.suggestion: Split into: create_archive_dir(), export_partition_to_jsonl(), compress_file(), drop_partition().

issue.description: Module-level mutable global 'calls' list violates v11.7 'No module-level side effects' rule
issue.suggestion: Move calls list inside run_verification function or encapsulate in a verification context class

issue.description: fake_encode function defined at module level with dependency on global 'calls' list; pollutes production namespace despite being test-only utility
issue.suggestion: Move fake_encode inside run_verification as a local function, or create a test-specific module. For CI tool, define it locally within the verification function

issue.description: Uses `sys.exit(main())` in `__main__` block. Blueprint AMEND-64 prohibits sys.exit() in library code, requiring RuntimeError instead. While this is a CLI script, the blueprint classifies it as library code.
issue.suggestion: Replace with `raise RuntimeError(main())` or restructure to return exit code and let caller handle exit. For CLI scripts, consider if this rule applies.

issue.description: Worker function mutates shared `results` list via side effect instead of returning value. Makes testing harder and obscures data flow.
issue.suggestion: Return the index from worker and collect via `future.result()`: `results = [f.result() for f in futures]`.

issue.description: calculate_entropy creates collections.Counter and log2_table for every call; for large tokens or many tokens this allocates O(n) memory and O(n) time per token
issue.suggestion: Cache log2_table per token length using functools.lru_cache; consider streaming entropy calculation for very long tokens; avoid Counter for single-pass frequency counting

issue.description: log2_table recreated for every calculate_entropy call; for repeated token lengths this is redundant computation
issue.suggestion: Add @functools.lru_cache(maxsize=128) to a helper _make_log2_table(length) function; or cache table in module-level dict keyed by length

issue.description: _check_batch_quota fetches quota/cost for providers_needed but then iterates all providers_in_batch again - redundant iteration and potential N+1 if called repeatedly without cache
issue.suggestion: Merge the two loops: after fetching, validate all providers_in_batch in single pass. Consider moving cache to module-level with TTL decorator instead of passing dicts around.

issue.description: _fetch_provider_values creates new cursor for each call when cursor=None - inefficient for repeated calls in loops
issue.suggestion: Callers should pass reusable cursor. Document this clearly. Consider making cursor mandatory and removing auto-create logic to force proper cursor management.

issue.description: sanitize function uses hardcoded sensitive_patterns list - not configurable, may miss organization-specific secret patterns
issue.suggestion: Make sensitive_patterns a parameter with default. Load from config file/env var for production deployments. Add regex support for high-entropy token detection.

issue.description: Imports psycopg2 at module level - hard dependency even if only SQLite is used in tests, violates dependency isolation
issue.suggestion: Move psycopg2 import inside get_db_connections or behind try/except with helpful error message. Allows testing with only sqlite3.

issue.description: Custom JsonFormatter duplicates functionality available in python-json-logger or structlog. Adds maintenance burden and potential bugs (e.g., missing standard fields).
issue.suggestion: Replace with: import pythonjsonlogger.jsonlogger.JsonFormatter or structlog. Configure via dictConfig. Remove custom class.

issue.description: reap_stale_jobs() uses CURRENT_TIMESTAMP in SQL; blueprint AMEND-63 requires datetime.now(timezone.utc) for timezone-aware timestamps
issue.suggestion: Compute lease expiry in Python using datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(seconds=lease_interval) and pass as parameter

issue.description: complete_job() relies on SQLite's CURRENT_TIMESTAMP; should use Python-side timezone-aware datetime per AMEND-63
issue.suggestion: Generate timestamps in Python with datetime.now(timezone.utc) and pass as parameters to UPDATE statements

issue.description: lease_interval, max_attempts, emergency_depth hardcoded in __init__; prevents environment-specific tuning and testing
issue.suggestion: Add optional parameters to __init__ with defaults; load from config object or environment variables

issue.description: Large raw SQL script in _init_schema() makes schema migrations difficult; no version tracking
issue.suggestion: Extract schema to separate .sql files; add schema_version table and migration runner for future changes

issue.description: Status and severity constants defined as module-level strings; no enum type safety or IDE autocomplete
issue.suggestion: Convert to Python enum.Enum classes (Status, Severity) for type checking and autocomplete

issue.description: enqueue() executes SELECT on counter table then INSERT; could combine with trigger logic to avoid round-trip
issue.suggestion: Remove explicit counter SELECT; rely on trigger-maintained counter for depth check via subquery in INSERT

issue.description: Global DB_PATH hinders parallel testing: all tests share same default path unless explicitly overridden
issue.suggestion: Remove module-level DB_PATH; require db_path parameter or use dependency injection pattern with a config class

issue.description: Inconsistent error handling: check_quota returns bool for business logic, record_usage returns None but raises on error; no unified pattern
issue.suggestion: Adopt consistent pattern: either raise exceptions for all failures (including quota exceeded) or use Result/Either types

issue.description: apply_quarantine_policy() iterates all token matches with finditer() even for non-analytical fields. The is_analytical check at line 195 happens after payload length check at line 198, wasting cycles on large non-analytical payloads.
issue.suggestion: Move is_analytical check to line 193 (before any processing). Return early if not analytical. Also consider compiling TOKEN_PATTERN with re.DOTALL if newlines should be included in tokens.

issue.description: Type aliases RegexPatternDict, CompiledRegexDict, AllowlistPatternDict defined but never used in type annotations. Code uses explicit Dict[str, Pattern[str]] instead, creating inconsistency and dead code.
issue.suggestion: Either use the aliases consistently (e.g., REGEX_RULES: RegexPatternDict = {...}) or remove the unused aliases.

issue.description: detect_high_entropy_tokens() calls _should_quarantine() which calls calculate_entropy() and _check_allowlist() for every token match. No caching of entropy/allowlist results for repeated tokens in same payload.
issue.suggestion: Add LRU cache to calculate_entropy and _check_allowlist (functools.lru_cache(maxsize=1024)). Since tokens repeat in logs, this avoids redundant computation.

issue.description: Configuration validation functions (_load_entropy_threshold, etc.) are repetitive boilerplate. Each does: get env, parse, validate range, raise ValueError. Could be consolidated into a generic validator.
issue.suggestion: Create a generic _load_config(name, default, parser, validator) function. Reduces ~50 lines of duplicate code and ensures consistent error messages.

issue.description: get_db() handles connection, schema migration, index management, and data migration. Violates single responsibility; hard to test and debug.
issue.suggestion: Split into: connect_db(), migrate_schema(), create_indexes(). Call migration once at startup, not per connection.

issue.description: Verdict inserted into verdicts table (append-only) - compliant with Section 30. However, triage_queue updates are in-place mutations without audit trail.
issue.suggestion: Consider adding audit log table for status transitions (pending->processing->completed/failed) with timestamps and worker ID for traceability.

issue.description: Print statements used for logging instead of logging module; not configurable, no log levels, hard to suppress in tests
issue.suggestion: Replace print() with logging.info()/logging.debug() using module logger

issue.description: Print statement in rollback_plan() uses same pattern
issue.suggestion: Replace with logging.info()

issue.description: DEFAULT_LEDGER_PATH hardcoded as relative path 'handoffs_ledger.log'; not configurable and problematic in production deployments
issue.suggestion: Make ledger path configurable via environment variable or config file; use absolute path based on XDG_DATA_HOME or /var/log

issue.description: __init__ doesn't validate that loaded model actually produces DIMENSION-sized embeddings. Could warn or error early.
issue.suggestion: After loading model, test encode a dummy string and verify dimension matches self.DIMENSION

issue.description: Fetches all partition names then filters in Python. Could push date filtering into SQL for efficiency.
issue.suggestion: Modify query to compute partition date and compare in WHERE clause, reducing data transfer.

issue.description: `fake_encode` defined at module level but only used in `run_verification`; pollutes module namespace and relies on global `calls`
issue.suggestion: Move `fake_encode` inside `run_verification` as a nested function that captures a local `calls` list, or make it a `staticmethod` of a test helper class.

issue.description: Hardcoded default prefixes in get_prefixes() may diverge from actual embedding service defaults, causing silent misconfiguration
issue.suggestion: Remove hardcoded defaults and require config file or environment variables. Fail fast if neither is present.

issue.description: ExitCode enum uses explicit integer values. Using auto() would prevent duplicate values and improve maintainability.
issue.suggestion: Change to: class ExitCode(Enum): SUCCESS = auto(); API_ERROR = auto(); ... and import auto from enum.

issue.description: calculate_entropy uses collections.Counter and manual log2 table. For short tokens (<100 chars), math.log2 in loop is fast enough; the table optimization adds complexity without measurable benefit.
issue.suggestion: Simplify to: return -sum((c/len(data)) * math.log2(c/len(data)) for c in Counter(data).values()) if data else 0.0. Remove log2_table.

issue.description: Module-level redact() and run_sanitization_check() functions depend on global _default_sanitizer, making unit testing difficult and preventing parallel use with different configs
issue.suggestion: Remove module-level functions; document Sanitizer class as primary API. If convenience functions needed, make them accept explicit sanitizer parameter

issue.description: The tool does not implement the required logging standard for audit trails as per Blueprint v11.8.
issue.suggestion: Replace print statements with the standard logging module configured to output to both stdout and a structured log file.
